about: data.europa.eu (the official EU open data portal): search EU and national open datasets, catalogues and data services, read dataset and catalogue metadata, find similar datasets, and export DCAT metadata.

commands.summary: Keyword search over open datasets, with optional facet filters, sorting and pagination

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort as field+direction. Comma-separate several keys. Fields: relevance, modified, title.en, issued (created).

params.name: facets
params.description: JSON object of facet filters. Keys: country, catalog, format, categories, keywords, scoring, hvdCategory. Values are arrays of ids, e.g. {"country":["nl"],"format":["CSV"]}

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (max ~1000) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Count matches for a query across all indexes (datasets, catalogues, data services, dataset series, editorial content)
List or search the data catalogues (national and EU portals) that publish datasets

params.name: q
params.description: Optional free-text query to filter catalogues

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort as field+direction, e.g. title.en+asc, modified+desc

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: List the country vocabulary (ids and multilingual labels) used for the country facet

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Max entries to return (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Get full metadata for one dataset: title, description, catalogue, country, keywords, distributions/download links

params.name: id
params.description: Dataset id (UUID or slug) as returned by search-datasets

commands.summary: Get metadata for one catalogue (publisher portal): title, description, homepage, country

params.name: id
params.description: Catalogue id, e.g. geodata-se, gdi-de, dataportaal-van-de-nederlandse-overheid

commands.summary: Find datasets similar to a given dataset (lower distance = more similar)
Get a dataset's full DCAT-AP metadata as a JSON-LD graph (distributions, licences, spatial coverage, contacts)
Export a dataset's DCAT-AP metadata as raw RDF text (RDF/XML, Turtle, N3 or N-Triples)
Get the RSS feed for a dataset, which tracks updates to its metadata and distributions
